[[Chest of Lumber]] is a reward for [[daily]] lumberer achievements.

== Acquisition ==
{{achievement list|reward=Chest of Lumber|expandable=y}}

== Contents ==
{{see|Chest of Lumber/historical|label=Historical seasonal drops}}
* Three times something of the following (items may drop multiple times):
** {{contains|Ancient Wood Log}} (1-3)
** {{contains|Elder Wood Log}} (1-3)
** {{contains|Hard Wood Log}} (1-3)
** {{contains|Seasoned Wood Log}} (1-3)
** {{contains|Soft Wood Log}} (1-3)
** {{contains|Green Wood Log}} (1-3)
* {{contains|Writ of Experience|chance=Guaranteed}}
* {{contains|Resonating Sliver|chance=Guaranteed}}
* {{coin|147}} – {{coin|227}}

== Trivia ==
* Added to the game with the [[Game updates/2014-12-16|December 16, 2014]] update, as part of the reworked daily achievement system.
* Historical variants:
{{Item variant table header | only fields=icon,link }} !! Notes
{{Item variant table row | id = 68290 | icon = Daily achievement chest (Wintersday).png }} || During Wintersday 2014 (also contained a {{item icon|Giant Wintersday Gift}})
{{Item variant table row | id = 68112 | icon = Daily achievement chest (gold).png }} || During Lunar New Year 2016-2017 (also contained a {{item icon|Homemade Lucky Envelope}})
|}
